in_marathi.name: Roopa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Roopa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Roopa is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'Rup' meaning form or appearance. In Hindu mythology, Roopa is the divine manifestation of Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of prosperity and beauty. She is also known as 'Sri Roopa' and is often depicted as a beautiful woman with golden complexion, four arms, and holding lotus flowers and a golden lotus. Roopa symbolizes the divine beauty and grace that adorns the universe and bestows prosperity and happiness.
